title: concurrent_access_stats
summary: Concurrent access statistics supporting multiple concurrent request workers that record visit counts and generate visit summaries, ensuring accurate counts and deadlock freedom.

domain_types.name: VisitSummary
domain_types.description: Pure in-memory visit summary payload with integer count and boolean flags, no synchronization or strings

resource_specs.name: stats_lock
resource_specs.description: Mutex protecting the shared visit counter and summary state

resource_specs.name: visit_count
resource_specs.description: Modeled total number of recorded visits, bounded to keep state space small

resource_specs.name: summary_ready
resource_specs.description: Modeled flag indicating whether a visit summary has been generated

clauses.text: The system must never deadlock under concurrent recorder_a and recorder_b execution.
At all reachable states, visit_count stays within 0..=2 (visit_count <= 2).
Whenever a visit is recorded (visit_count > 0), on all execution paths summary_ready eventually becomes true.
Both recorder_a and recorder_b workers must be able to complete execution.
Construct, inspect, and update VisitSummary entries and pure integer visit counts inside sequential/type holes without synchronization, loops, unsafe, or String formatting.
